newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-D.Jones to wind down Martin's - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-D.Jones to wind down Martin's - paper.

text.p: Retailer David Jones Ltd plans to wind down the operations of its troubled South Australian John Martin's operations with a A$100 redevelopment planned for its Adelaide city site, the Adelaide Advertiser reported.
The newspaper said a A$100 million luxury hotel and shopping complex would be built on the John Martin's Rundle Mall site, expected to retain the city store but on a much smaller scale.
Two other John Martin's stores in suburban Adelaide and Elizabeth eventually would be re-badged under the David Jones banner, the newspaper said.
It said it was understood that a major property group was involved in the Rundle Mall redevelopment project.
David Jones said in January that sales at John Martin's for the first five months of 1996/97 were down 21.8 percent on the corresponding months in 1995/96.
